record.title: Burkina Faso COVID land and rail border closure
record.scope: National land and rail passenger crossings; freight exempt
record.direction: Entry and exit covered by reopening decree
record.enforcement: Initial speech establishes policy; Yendéré field reporting documents partial operational relaxation at endpoint.
record.relationship: Asymmetric neighbouring restrictions continued, notably W-004 Côte d’Ivoire; do not infer region-wide reopening.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no inference of status at the research cutoff.
record.uncertainty: 21 March is the date in the order (midnight wording retained without assuming a clock boundary). 1 December ends Burkina-side prohibition, not neighbouring states’ restrictions. Yendéré reporting establishes local resumption but not uniform bilateral bus services. COBAP August 2020 endpoint concerns air and is not accepted for land.
